passages.text: David constructed buildings for himself in the City of David, and he prepared a place for the ark of God and pitched a tent for it.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David built houses for himself.
He built these houses in the City of David.
David prepared a place for the ark of God.
He set up a tent for the ark.
passages.original: וַיַּֽעַשׂ־ ל֥וֹ בָתִּ֖ים בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וַיָּ֤כֶן מָקוֹם֙ לַֽאֲר֣וֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיֶּט־ ל֖וֹ אֹֽהֶל׃

passages.text: Then David said, “No one but the Levites may carry the ark of God, because the LORD has chosen them to carry the ark of the LORD and to minister before Him forever.”
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David spoke to the people.
David said only the Levites may carry the ark of God.
The ark of God is holy.
The LORD chose the Levites for this task.
The LORD chose the Levites to carry the ark of the LORD.
The LORD chose the Levites to serve Him forever.
passages.original: אָ֚ז אָמַ֣ר דָּוִ֔יד לֹ֤א לָשֵׂאת֙ אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים כִּ֖י אִם־ הַלְוִיִּ֑ם כִּי־ בָ֣ם׀ בָּחַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה לָשֵׂ֞את אֶת־ אֲר֧וֹן יְהוָ֛ה וּֽלְשָׁרְת֖וֹ עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃ס

passages.text: And David assembled all Israel in Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the LORD to the place he had prepared for it.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David gathered all the people of Israel.
He brought them to Jerusalem.
David wanted to move the ark of the LORD.
He had prepared a special place for the ark.
David planned to bring the ark to this place.
passages.original: וַיַּקְהֵ֥ל דָּוִ֛יד אֶת־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־ יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְהַעֲלוֹת֙ אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ מְקוֹמ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ הֵכִ֥ין לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Then he gathered together the descendants of Aaron and the Levites: From the Kohathites, Uriel the chief and 120 of his relatives; from the Merarites, Asaiah the chief and 220 of his relatives; from the Gershomites, Joel the chief and 130 of his relatives; from the Elizaphanites, Shemaiah the chief and 200 of his relatives; from the Hebronites, Eliel the chief and 80 of his relatives; and from the Uzzielites, Amminadab the chief and 112 of his relatives.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David gathered the descendants of Aaron.
David gathered the Levites.
The Levites were the tribe chosen by God to serve Him.
The descendants of Kohath were part of the Levites.
Uriel was the chief of the Kohathites.
Uriel had 120 relatives with him.
The descendants of Merari were part of the Levites.
Asaiah was the chief of the Merarites.
Asaiah had 220 relatives with him.
The descendants of Gershom were part of the Levites.
Joel was the chief of the Gershomites.
Joel had 130 relatives with him.
The descendants of Elizaphan were part of the Levites.
Shemaiah was the chief of the Elizaphanites.
Shemaiah had 200 relatives with him.
The descendants of Hebron were part of the Levites.
Eliel was the chief of the Hebronites.
Eliel had 80 relatives with him.
The descendants of Uzziel were part of the Levites.
Amminadab was the chief of the Uzzielites.
Amminadab had 112 relatives with him.
passages.original: וַיֶּאֱסֹ֥ף דָּוִ֛יד אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י אַֽהֲרֹ֖ן וְאֶת־ הַלְוִיִּֽם׃ לִבְנֵ֖י קְהָ֑ת אוּרִיאֵ֣ל הַשָּׂ֔ר וְאֶחָ֖יו מֵאָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ס לִבְנֵ֖י מְרָרִ֑י עֲשָׂיָ֣ה הַשָּׂ֔ר וְאֶחָ֖יו מָאתַ֥יִם וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ס לִבְנֵ֖י גֵּרְשׁ֑וֹם יוֹאֵ֣ל הַשָּׂ֔ר וְאֶחָ֖יו מֵאָ֥ה וּשְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃ס לִבְנֵ֖י אֱלִֽיצָפָ֑ן שְׁמַֽעְיָ֥ה הַשָּׂ֖ר וְאֶחָ֥יו מָאתָֽיִם׃ס לִבְנֵ֖י חֶבְר֑וֹן אֱלִיאֵ֥ל הַשָּׂ֖ר וְאֶחָ֥יו שְׁמוֹנִֽים׃ס לִבְנֵ֖י עֻזִּיאֵ֑ל עַמִּינָדָ֣ב הַשָּׂ֔ר וְאֶחָ֕יו מֵאָ֖ה וּשְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ס

passages.text: David summoned the priests Zadok and Abiathar and the Levites Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David called the priests.
The priests were Zadok and Abiathar.
David also called the Levites.
The Levites were Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab.
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א דָוִ֔יד לְצָד֥וֹק וּלְאֶבְיָתָ֖ר הַכֹּֽהֲנִ֑ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֗ם לְאֽוּרִיאֵ֤ל עֲשָׂיָה֙ וְיוֹאֵ֣ל שְׁמַֽעְיָ֔ה וֶאֱלִיאֵ֖ל וְעַמִּינָדָֽב׃

passages.text: And he said to them, “You are the heads of the Levitical families. You and your relatives must consecrate yourselves so that you may bring the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, to the place I have prepared for it.
passages.sermon:
David spoke to the leaders of the Levites.
He said, "You are the heads of the families of the Levites."
"You and your relatives must make yourselves holy."
"You must do this so you can carry the ark of the LORD."
The LORD is the God of Israel.
You must bring the ark to the place I have prepared for it."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֔ם אַתֶּ֛ם רָאשֵׁ֥י הָאָב֖וֹת לַלְוִיִּ֑ם הִֽתְקַדְּשׁוּ֙ אַתֶּ֣ם וַאֲחֵיכֶ֔ם וְהַֽעֲלִיתֶ֗ם אֵ֣ת אֲר֤וֹן יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל־ הֲכִינ֖וֹתִי לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: It was because you Levites were not with us the first time that the LORD our God burst forth in anger against us. For we did not consult Him about the proper order.”
passages.sermon:
David spoke to the Levites.
David said, “You Levites were not with us the first time.
The LORD is our God.
The LORD became angry with us.
The LORD punished us.
We did not ask the LORD how to do things the right way.
We did not follow His instructions.”
passages.original: כִּ֛י לְמַבָּרִ֥אשׁוֹנָ֖ה לֹ֣א אַתֶּ֑ם פָּרַ֨ץ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ בָּ֔נוּ כִּי־ לֹ֥א דְרַשְׁנֻ֖הוּ כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

passages.text: So the priests and Levites consecrated themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.
passages.sermon:
The priests and the Levites prepared themselves.
They made themselves holy.
They did this so they could carry the ark.
The ark belonged to the LORD.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
passages.original: וַיִּֽתְקַדְּשׁ֔וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֑ם לְהַעֲל֕וֹת אֶת־ אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And the Levites carried the ark of God on their shoulders with the poles, as Moses had commanded in accordance with the word of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The Levites were a special group from the tribe of Israel.
They served God in the temple.
The Levites carried the ark of God.
They lifted the ark onto their shoulders.
They used poles to carry the ark.
Moses had commanded them to do this.
Moses gave this command because the LORD had spoken it.
The Levites obeyed the word of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׂא֣וּ בְנֵֽי־ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם אֵ֚ת אֲר֣וֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה בִּכְתֵפָ֥ם בַּמֹּט֖וֹת עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃פ

passages.text: David also told the leaders of the Levites to appoint their relatives as singers to lift up their voices with joy, accompanied by musical instruments—harps, lyres, and cymbals.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David spoke to the leaders of the Levites.
The Levites were a tribe chosen to serve God in the temple.
David gave the Levite leaders a command.
He told them to appoint their relatives as singers.
These singers would use musical instruments.
The instruments were harps, lyres, and cymbals.
The singers would lift up their voices with joy.
They would make music to celebrate.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִיד֮ לְשָׂרֵ֣י הַלְוִיִּם֒ לְהַֽעֲמִ֗יד אֶת־ אֲחֵיהֶם֙ הַמְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים בִּכְלֵי־ שִׁ֛יר נְבָלִ֥ים וְכִנֹּר֖וֹת וּמְצִלְתָּ֑יִם מַשְׁמִיעִ֥ים לְהָרִֽים־ בְּק֖וֹל לְשִׂמְחָֽה׃פ

passages.text: So the Levites appointed Heman son of Joel; from his brothers, Asaph son of Berechiah; from their brothers the Merarites, Ethan son of Kushaiah; and with them their brothers next in rank: Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, and the gatekeepers Obed-edom and Jeiel.
passages.sermon:
The Levites chose leaders for the music.
They appointed Heman son of Joel.
They also appointed Asaph son of Berechiah from Heman’s brothers.
They chose Ethan son of Kushaiah from the Merarite brothers.
Other Levites served with them.
These men were next in rank.
Their names were Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, and Mikneiah.
Obed-edom and Jeiel served as gatekeepers.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲמִ֣ידוּ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם אֵ֚ת הֵימָ֣ן בֶּן־ יוֹאֵ֔ל וּמִ֨ן־ אֶחָ֔יו אָסָ֖ף בֶּן־ בֶּֽרֶכְיָ֑הוּס וּמִן־ בְּנֵ֤י מְרָרִי֙ אֲחֵיהֶ֔ם אֵיתָ֖ן בֶּן־ קֽוּשָׁיָֽהוּ׃ וְעִמָּהֶ֖ם אֲחֵיהֶ֣ם הַמִּשְׁנִ֑ים זְכַרְיָ֡הוּ בֵּ֡ן וְיַֽעֲזִיאֵ֡ל וּשְׁמִֽירָמ֡וֹת וִיחִיאֵ֣ל׀ וְעֻנִּ֡י אֱלִיאָ֡ב וּבְנָיָ֡הוּ וּמַֽעֲשֵׂיָ֡הוּ וּמַתִּתְיָהוּ֩ וֶאֱלִ֨יפְלֵ֜הוּ וּמִקְנֵיָ֨הוּ וְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם וִֽיעִיאֵ֖ל הַשֹּׁעֲרִֽים׃

passages.text: The musicians Heman, Asaph, and Ethan were to sound the bronze cymbals.
passages.sermon: Heman, Asaph, and Ethan were musicians.\r\nThey played bronze cymbals.\r\nThey made the sound heard.
passages.original: וְהַמְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים הֵימָ֥ן אָסָ֖ף וְאֵיתָ֑ן בִּמְצִלְתַּ֥יִם נְחֹ֖שֶׁת לְהַשְׁמִֽיעַ׃

passages.text: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah were to play the harps according to Alamoth.
passages.sermon: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah were Levites.\r\nThese men played the harps.\r\nThey played the harps according to Alamoth.
passages.original: וּזְכַרְיָ֨ה וַעֲזִיאֵ֜ל וּשְׁמִֽירָמ֤וֹת וִֽיחִיאֵל֙ וְעֻנִּ֣י וֶֽאֱלִיאָ֔ב וּמַעֲשֵׂיָ֖הוּ וּבְנָיָ֑הוּ בִּנְבָלִ֖ים עַל־ עֲלָמֽוֹת׃

passages.text: And Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah were to lead the music with lyres according to Sheminith.
passages.sermon:
Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah were Levites.
They were musicians.
They played lyres.
They led the music.
They played according to Sheminith.
passages.original: וּמַתִּתְיָ֣הוּ וֶאֱלִֽיפְלֵ֗הוּ וּמִקְנֵיָ֙הוּ֙ וְעֹבֵ֣ד אֱדֹ֔ם וִֽיעִיאֵ֖ל וַעֲזַזְיָ֑הוּ בְּכִנֹּר֥וֹת עַל־ הַשְּׁמִינִ֖ית לְנַצֵּֽחַ׃

passages.text: Chenaniah the head Levite was the director of the music because he was highly skilled.
passages.sermon:
Chenaniah was a Levite.
He was the head of the Levites.
He directed the music.
He led because he was highly skilled.
passages.original: וּכְנַנְיָ֥הוּ שַֽׂר־ הַלְוִיִּ֖ם בְּמַשָּׂ֑א יָסֹר֙ בַּמַּשָּׂ֔א כִּ֥י מֵבִ֖ין הֽוּא׃

passages.text: Berechiah and Elkanah were to be guardians of the ark.
passages.sermon: Berechiah was a guardian of the ark.\r\nElkanah was a guardian of the ark.
passages.original: וּבֶֽרֶכְיָה֙ וְאֶלְקָנָ֔ה שֹׁעֲרִ֖ים לָאָרֽוֹן׃

passages.text: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer—the priests—were to blow the trumpets before the ark of God. Obed-edom and Jehiah were also to be guardians of the ark.
passages.sermon:
Shebaniah was a priest.
Joshaphat was a priest.
Nethanel was a priest.
Amasai was a priest.
Zechariah was a priest.
Benaiah was a priest.
Eliezer was a priest.
These priests blew trumpets.
They stood before the ark of God.
Obed-edom guarded the ark.
Jehiah guarded the ark.
passages.original: וּשְׁבַנְיָ֡הוּ וְיֽוֹשָׁפָ֡ט וּנְתַנְאֵ֡ל וַעֲמָשַׂ֡י וּ֠זְכַרְיָהוּ וּבְנָיָ֤הוּ וֶֽאֱלִיעֶ֙זֶר֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים מַחֲצֹצְרִים בַּחֲצֹ֣צְר֔וֹת לִפְנֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעֹבֵ֤ד אֱדֹם֙ וִֽיחִיָּ֔ה שֹׁעֲרִ֖ים לָאָרֽוֹן׃

passages.text: So David, the elders of Israel, and the commanders of thousands went with rejoicing to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD from the house of Obed-edom.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
The elders of Israel were leaders among the people.
The commanders of thousands were military leaders.
David, the elders, and the commanders went together.
They went to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
The ark was at the house of Obed-edom.
They went with rejoicing.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דָוִ֛יד וְזִקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְשָׂרֵ֣י הָאֲלָפִ֑ים הַהֹֽלְכִ֗ים לְֽהַעֲל֞וֹת אֶת־ אֲר֧וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֛ה מִן־ בֵּ֥ית עֹבֵֽד־ אֱדֹ֖ם בְּשִׂמְחָֽה׃ס

passages.text: And because God helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
passages.sermon:
God helped the Levites.
The Levites were carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
The Levites sacrificed seven bulls.
The Levites sacrificed seven rams.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בֶּעְזֹ֣ר הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶ֨ת־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם נֹשְׂאֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּזְבְּח֥וּ שִׁבְעָֽה־ פָרִ֖ים וְשִׁבְעָ֥ה אֵילִֽים׃

passages.text: Now David was dressed in a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who were carrying the ark, as well as the singers and Chenaniah, the director of music for the singers. David also wore a linen ephod.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David wore a robe made of fine linen.
All the Levites who carried the ark wore fine linen robes.
The singers wore fine linen robes.
Chenaniah was the director of music for the singers.
Chenaniah wore a fine linen robe.
David also wore a linen ephod.
passages.original: וְדָוִ֞יד מְכֻרְבָּ֣ל׀ בִּמְעִ֣יל בּ֗וּץ וְכָל־ הַלְוִיִּם֙ הַנֹּשְׂאִ֣ים אֶת־ הָאָר֔וֹן וְהַמְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים וּכְנַנְיָ֛ה הַשַּׂ֥ר הַמַּשָּׂ֖א הַמְשֹֽׁרְרִ֑ים וְעַל־ דָּוִ֖יד אֵפ֥וֹד בָּֽד׃

passages.text: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, with the sounding of rams’ horns and trumpets, and with cymbals and the music of harps and lyres.
passages.sermon:
All Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
They shouted loudly.
They sounded rams’ horns.
They blew trumpets.
They played cymbals.
They made music with harps.
They played lyres.
passages.original: וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מַעֲלִים֙ אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֔ה בִּתְרוּעָה֙ וּבְק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָ֔ר וּבַחֲצֹצְר֖וֹת וּבִמְצִלְתָּ֑יִם מַשְׁמִעִ֕ים בִּנְבָלִ֖ים וְכִנֹּרֽוֹת׃

passages.text: As the ark of the covenant of the LORD was entering the City of David, Saul’s daughter Michal looked down from a window and saw King David dancing and celebrating, and she despised him in her heart.
passages.sermon:
The ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the City of David.
Michal was Saul’s daughter.
Michal looked out from a window.
Michal saw King David.
King David was dancing.
King David was celebrating.
Michal despised David in her heart.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י אֲרוֹן֙ בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה בָּ֖א עַד־ עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וּמִיכַ֨ל בַּת־ שָׁא֜וּל נִשְׁקְפָ֣ה׀ בְּעַ֣ד הַחַלּ֗וֹן וַתֵּ֨רֶא אֶת־ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִיד֙ מְרַקֵּ֣ד וּמְשַׂחֵ֔ק וַתִּ֥בֶז ל֖וֹ בְּלִבָּֽהּ׃פ
